definitions.explanation: A product manufactured in large quantities using standardized processes, as opposed to handmade or custom-made items.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{量産品|りょうさんひん}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧だ。
{量産品|りょうさんひん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheap because it's a mass-produced item.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦{工芸品|こうげいひん}→工芸品：15367_kougeihin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{量産品|りょうさんひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{温|あたた}かみ→温かみ：25336_atatakami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Traditional crafts have a warmth and individuality that mass-produced items lack, but they are also more expensive.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{量産|りょうさん}→量産：14441_ryousan⟧ (mass production) and ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (product, item). Often used in contrast with ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧ (handmade), {一点物|いってんもの} (one-of-a-kind item), or {特注品|とくちゅうひん} (custom-made item).

The word can carry a slightly negative nuance, implying lack of individuality or lower quality compared to artisanal products. In discussions of traditional crafts, the distinction between {量産品|りょうさんひん} and ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧ is culturally significant in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {量産品|りょうさんひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧: mass-produced vs. handmade
- ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧{量産品|りょうさんひん}: cheap mass-produced goods
- {量産品|りょうさんひん}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧: mass-production level

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既製品|きせいひん}→既製品：08304_kiseihin⟧: ready-made product — emphasizes being pre-made rather than custom
- {大量生産品|たいりょうせいさんひん}: mass-produced product — longer synonym with the same meaning
- {一点物|いってんもの}: one-of-a-kind item — the opposite, a unique handcrafted piece
